overall.assessment: Prema prikazanoj strukturi, podcast snažno promiče molitvu, Božje milosrđe, povjerenje u Krista, obraćenje i praktičnu duhovnu budnost, a evanđeoska poruka da se ne očajava može biti izvor nade i ustrajnosti. Ipak, niz tema iz bloka o duhovnoj borbi nosi rizik pretjeranog pojednostavljivanja: sumnja, društveni nemiri, ubojstvo ili stručna psihološka pomoć mogu se prikazati prvenstveno kao očitovanja zla, umjesto da se razlučuju osobna odgovornost, psihološki čimbenici, društveni uzroci i dostojanstvo uključenih osoba. Naglasak da neprijatelj nije čovjek i da se oprema Božja mora živjeti, a ne samo izgovarati, ublažava taj rizik; ipak, samo iz tematskog pregleda nije moguće prosuditi koliko ga stvarno sprječava u izvedbi. Zato je cjelina djelomično, ali ne beznačajno, usklađena s katoličkom vjerom: njezina pobožna i misionarska jezgra pozitivna je, dok način tumačenja psihologije, društvenih događaja i duhovne borbe zahtijeva oprez.
seeds_of_logos: Krunica Božjega milosrđa, litanije, otajstva svjetla i posvete usmjeravaju pozornost na Kristovu muku, milosrđe, obraćenje i euharistiju; takvi molitveni oblici mogu njegovati povjerenje u Boga i zajedničku molitvu.

Tumačenje opreme Božje kao nečega što se razumije i živi, a ne kao puke recitacije, dobro se podudara s katoličkim shvaćanjem duhovne borbe: molitva, Božja riječ, sakramenti, djela ljubavi, zajednički život i poslanje sastavni su dijelovi kršćanske budnosti.

Naglasak na povjerenju, ustrajnosti i nepredavanju očaju daje pastoralno vrijedan odgovor na patnju, dok svjedočanstvo o zacjeljivanju rane može upućivati na važnost nade i zajedničke molitve, ako se ne predstavlja kao univerzalno jamstvo izlječenja.

Poziv na molitvu u obitelji, krunicu na trgovima i uključivanje vjernika u javni život može poticati zajedništvo i evangelizacijsko svjedočenje, pod uvjetom da inicijativa i prikupljanje donacija budu transparentni i usmjereni služenju, a ne pritisku ili stranačkom svrstavanja.

Upozorenje na idolopoklonstvo može biti korisno kada označuje da bilo koja ljudska aktivnost postaje apsolutna i potiskuje Boga; ipak, sport sam po sebi nije suparnik vjeri, nego se može vrednovati prema tome služi li dostojanstvu osobe, razvoju i zajedništvu.
concerns: Izrazito ratnička slika duhovne borbe može biti biblijski opravdana, ali zahtijeva jasno razgraničenje: kršćanin se bori protiv zla i grijeha, ne protiv ljudi. Ako se pojedince opisuje kao osobe pod vlašću zloga, postoji opasnost stigmatizacije i slabljenja poziva na ljubav prema bližnjemu; kršćanska društvena etika izričito odbacuje nasilje i zahtijeva poštovanje dostojanstva svake osobe.

Povezivanje psihologije s idolopoklonstvom može stvoriti lažan izbor između vjere i stručne pomoći. Katolički pristup može kritički vrednovati antropološke pretpostavke pojedinih teorija, ali priznaje da legitimne psihološke analize i terapije mogu pomoći u dijagnosticiranju i liječenju poteškoća.

Tumačenje sumnje kao najjačeg đavoljeg oružja koje rađa izdaju može zanemariti razliku između prolazne nedoumice, razboritog preispitivanja i svjesnog odbacivanja dobra. Ako se ta razlika ne objasni, vjernike može potaknuti na strah, samookrivljavanje ili nepovjerenje unutar zajednice.

Prikaz ubojstva, francuskih nemira i stanja Hrvatske kao znakova duhovne bolesti ili posljedice napuštanja Boga može biti teološki reduktivan ako izostavi konkretne ljudske, društvene i političke uzroke. Posebno je važno ne instrumentalizirati žrtve nasilja i ne pretvarati tragedije u jednostavne dokaze protiv skupina ili društva.

Budući da pregled ne donosi puni sadržaj ni kontekst izjava, nije moguće utvrditi jesu li tvrdnje o prorokovanju, uklanjanju emisija, svjedočanstvu iscjeljenja, obiteljskoj poslušnosti i donacijama iznesene uz potrebne ograde; u svakom od tih područja potrebni su istinoljubivost, razboritost i poštovanje slobode savjesti.
overall.theological_context: Ef 6,10–18 daje biblijski okvir za sliku opreme Božje, ali se ta duhovna borba mora razumjeti kao borba protiv zla, a ne protiv ljudskih osoba; Gaudete et exsultate 162 uz molitvu i Božju riječ navodi misu, klanjanje, ispovijed, djela ljubavi, život zajednice i poslanje kao sredstva duhovne budnosti. Socijalni nauk Crkve zahtijeva da se društveni sukobi prosuđuju uz zaštitu ljudskog dostojanstva i odbacivanje nasilja, a crkveni dokument o sportu pokazuje da se kultura i sport ne smiju unaprijed odbacivati, nego vrednovati prema tome služe li cjelovitom razvoju osobe i zajedničkom dobru. Za procjenu konkretnog izlaganja ostaje važno razlikovati duhovno razlučivanje od neutemeljenih dijagnoza, te pobožno svjedočanstvo od tvrdnje koja bi obećavala zajamčen ishod.

overall.assessment_en: According to the presented structure, the podcast strongly promotes prayer, the Divine Mercy, trust in Christ, conversion, and practical spiritual vigilance, and the evangelical message not to despair can be a source of hope and perseverance. Nevertheless, a series of topics from the block on spiritual warfare carries the risk of oversimplification: doubt, social unrest, murder, or professional psychological help may be presented primarily as manifestations of evil, instead of discerning personal responsibility, psychological factors, societal causes, and the dignity of the persons involved. The emphasis that the enemy is not man and that the armor of God must be lived, and not merely recited, mitigates that risk; still, from the thematic overview alone it is not possible to judge how much it actually prevents it in delivery. Therefore, the whole is partially, but not insignificantly, aligned with the Catholic faith: its devotional and missionary core is positive, while the manner of interpreting psychology, societal events, and spiritual warfare requires caution.
overall.theological_context_en: Eph 6:10–18 provides the biblical framework for the image of the armor of God, but that spiritual warfare must be understood as a battle against evil, not against human persons; Gaudete et exsultate 162, alongside prayer and the Word of God, lists Mass, Eucharistic adoration, confession (sacrament of reconciliation), works of charity, community life, and mission as means of spiritual vigilance. The Social Teaching of the Church requires that social conflicts be judged with the protection of human dignity and the rejection of violence, and the Church document on sports shows that culture and sports should not be dismissed in advance, but valued according to whether they serve the integral development of the person and the common good. To evaluate the specific exposition, it remains important to distinguish spiritual discernment from unfounded diagnoses, and pious testimony from a claim that would promise a guaranteed outcome.
seeds_of_logos_en: The Chaplet of the Divine Mercy, the litanies, the Luminous Mysteries, and the consecrations direct attention to Christ's Passion, mercy, conversion, and the Eucharist; such prayer forms can nurture trust in God and communal prayer.

The interpretation of the armor of God as something that is understood and lived, rather than as a mere recitation, aligns well with the Catholic understanding of spiritual warfare: prayer, the Word of God, the sacraments, works of charity, community life, and mission are integral parts of Christian vigilance.

The emphasis on trust, perseverance, and not yielding to despair provides a pastorally valuable response to suffering, while the testimony about the healing of the wound can point to the importance of hope and communal prayer, if it is not presented as a universal guarantee of healing.

The call to prayer in the family, the Rosary in public squares, and the involvement of believers in public life can foster communion and evangelistic witness, provided that the initiative and the collection of donations are transparent and oriented toward service, rather than pressure or partisan alignment.

The warning against idolatry can be beneficial when it signifies that any human activity becomes absolute and supplants God; nevertheless, sports in themselves are not a competitor to faith, but can be evaluated according to whether they serve the dignity of the person, development, and communion.
concerns_en: A distinctly martial image of spiritual warfare may be biblically justified, but it requires a clear demarcation: the Christian fights against evil and sin, not against people. If individuals are described as persons under the power of the evil one, there is a danger of stigmatization and of weakening the call to love one's neighbor; Christian social ethics explicitly rejects violence and demands respect for the dignity of every person.

Linking psychology with idolatry can create a false choice between faith and professional help. The Catholic approach can critically evaluate the anthropological premises of particular theories, but it recognizes that legitimate psychological analyses and therapies can assist in diagnosing and treating difficulties.

Interpreting doubt as the devil's strongest weapon that gives birth to betrayal may ignore the distinction between fleeting hesitation, prudent questioning, and a conscious rejection of good. If that distinction is not explained, it can lead believers into fear, self-blame, or mistrust within the community.

The depiction of murder, the French riots, and the state of Croatia as signs of spiritual illness or the consequence of abandoning God can be theologically reductive if it omits concrete human, social, and political causes. It is especially important not to instrumentalize victims of violence and not to turn tragedies into simplistic evidence against groups or society.

Since the overview does not provide the full content or context of the statements, it is not possible to establish whether claims about prophesying, the removal of episodes, the testimony of healing, family obedience, and donations were presented with the necessary caveats; in each of these areas, truthfulness, prudence, and respect for freedom of conscience are required.

sections.subtitle: Uvod u molitvu: evanđelje o proroku koji ne smije poginuti izvan Jeruzalema
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj pozdravlja gledatelje i slušatelje medija Ora et Labora i najavljuje evanđelje dana
sections.content:
Emisija medija **Ora et Labora** iz Međugorja, koju prema službenim metapodacima priprema dr. sc. Vladimir Grebenar, bacc. theol., počinje kratkim pozdravom „gospodi, dragim gledateljima i slušateljima“. Voditelj odmah najavljuje misao vodilju dana. Evanđelje dana nosi rečenicu: **„Ne priliči da prorok pogine izvan Jeruzalema.“**

Nakon te najave nema dodatnih objašnjenja. Voditelj se prekriži zazivom „U ime Oca i Sina i Duha Svetoga“ i time otvara dugi molitveni blok. Taj blok prethodi tumačenju Svetoga pisma i u ovoj epizodi traje više od pola sata. Evanđelje najavljeno na početku tako ostaje u pozadini cijelog molitvenog dijela, kao tema kojoj će se emisija vratiti tek kasnije.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u skladu s katoličkom vjerom: navodi misao iz Lk 13,33 i opisuje uobičajeno otvaranje molitve znakom križa. Budući da se evanđeoska rečenica ovdje samo najavljuje, a ne tumači, iz ovog ulomka nije moguće procijeniti produbljuje li emisija njezino značenje.
magisterium.enrichment: U Lk 13,33 Isus govori o svojem putu prema Jeruzalemu i smrti koja ga ondje čeka; rečenica se odnosi na njegovo predstojeće trpljenje, a ne na opće pravilo o mjestu smrti proroka. Katekizam ističe Isusovo sjećanje na proroke ubijene u Jeruzalemu, ali i njegovu želju da okupi grad i njegov narod.

Since the Gospel sentence is only announced here and not interpreted, from this excerpt it is not possible to evaluate whether the episode deepens its meaning.

sections.subtitle_en: Introduction to prayer: the gospel of the prophet who must not perish outside of Jerusalem
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host greets viewers and listeners of the media Ora et Labora and announces the gospel of the day
sections.content_en:
The broadcast of the media **Ora et Labora** from Međugorje, which according to official metadata is prepared by Dr. Vladimir Grebenar, Bacc. Theol., begins with a short greeting to "the gentlemen, dear viewers, and listeners." The host immediately announces the guiding thought of the day. The gospel of the day carries the sentence: **"It is impossible that a prophet should perish outside of Jerusalem."**

After that announcement, there are no additional explanations. The host crosses himself with the invocation "In the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit" and thereby opens a long prayer block. That block precedes the interpretation of Sacred Scripture and in this episode lasts more than half an hour. The gospel announced at the beginning thus remains in the background of the entire prayer part, as a topic to which the broadcast will return only later.

sections.subtitle: Molitva oslobođenja: „vežem sve zle sile i snage“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara molitvu oslobođenja i zaštite od zlih sila
sections.content:
Prvi dio molitvenog bloka je **molitva oslobođenja i zaštite**. Voditelj u ime Isusovo „uzima vlast“ i veže sve zle sile i snage. Pritom ih detaljno nabraja prema prostorima u kojima mogu djelovati:

- u zraku i na zemlji,
- u vodi i u podzemlju,
- na onome svijetu,
- u prirodi i u vatri.

Nakon toga molitva prelazi u hvalu. Gospodin se ispovijeda kao „Gospodin nad svim svemirom“, a slava mu se daje „u ime njegova stvorenja“. Voditelj zatim u Božje ime veže sve demonske sile koje su „došle protiv nas i naših obitelji“. Sve okupljene stavlja pod zaštitu **dragocjene krvi** prolivene na križu.

U molitvu su uključeni i nebeski zagovornici. Od Marije se, kao majke, traži zaštita i zagovor kod Presvetog Srca Isusova za sve obitelji, uz molbu: „Zaogrni nas svojim plaštem ljubavi, da se prestraši neprijatelj.“ Sveti Mihovil i anđeli čuvari pozvani su da brane obitelji u borbi protiv zla „što obilazi svijetom“.

Vrhunac ovog dijela je izravna zapovijed. U ime Isusovo voditelj zapovijeda svim silama i snagama zla da „odstupe istog časa“ od prisutnih, njihovih domova i njihove zemlje. Molitva završava zahvalom Isusu kao „vjernom Bogu“ koji „osjeća s nama“.

magisterium.assessment: Molitva je u osnovi usklađena s katoličkom vjerom kada zaziva Božju zaštitu, oslanja se na Kristovu krv i traži Marijin zagovor te pomoć svetoga Mihovila i anđela. Ipak, izravno zapovijedanje zlim duhovima u ime Isusovo može nalikovati imperativnom obredu egzorcizma, a taj je oblik u službenom obredu pridržan svećeniku.
concerns: Službeni obred razlikuje zazivnu molitvu od imperativne formule egzorcizma i izričito upućuje vjernike da ne izgovaraju tu formulu dok je izgovara svećenik; zato bi bilo primjerenije da voditelj moli Boga da oslobodi i zaštiti, umjesto da sam zapovijeda zlim silama da odmah odstupe.

Nabrajanje demonskog djelovanja u zraku, vodi, podzemlju, vatri, prirodi i „na onome svijetu” nije samo po sebi jasno proturječno nauku, ali može ostaviti dojam da je riječ o utvrđenoj katoličkoj kartografiji zlih duhova; opisani izvori to ne potvrđuju.
Izraz „uzimamo vlast” valja razumjeti kao oslanjanje na Krista i molitvu za Božju zaštitu, a ne kao osobnu ili automatsku vlast nad duhovnim silama.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička molitva za zaštitu od zla ima biblijsko uporište: izvor navodi Pavlov poziv da se uzme „sva oprema Božja” kako bi se vjernik održao u dan zla, kao i psalam koji govori da Gospodin čuva od zla. Službeni obred također poznaje zazivanje svetoga Mihovila, zagovor Marije i anđela te molitve za oslobođenje, ali ih smješta u crkveni poredak i naglašava Kristovu pobjedu, a ne samostalnu moć molitelja. Zato bi molitva bila jasnije usklađena kada bi zapovjedne dijelove preoblikovala u prošnje Bogu za zaštitu obitelji i oslobođenje od svakoga zla.

magisterium.assessment_en: The prayer is fundamentally aligned with the Catholic faith when it invokes God's protection, relies on the Blood of Christ, and seeks Mary's intercession and the help of Saint Michael and the angels. Nevertheless, directly commanding evil spirits in Jesus' name may resemble the imperative rite of exorcism, and that form in the official rite is reserved for a priest.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic prayer for protection against evil has biblical grounding: the source cites Paul's call to put on "the whole armor of God" so that the believer may stand in the evil day, as well as the psalm that says the Lord preserves from evil. The official rite likewise knows the invocation of Saint Michael, the intercession of Mary and the angels, and prayers for deliverance, but it places them within the ecclesiastical order and emphasizes Christ's victory, rather than the independent power of the one praying. Therefore, the prayer would be more clearly aligned if the commanding portions were rephrased into petitions to God for the protection of families and deliverance from all evil.
concerns_en: The official rite distinguishes deprecatory prayer from the imperative formula of exorcism and explicitly instructs the faithful not to recite that formula while the priest recites it; therefore, it would be more appropriate for the host to pray to God to deliver and protect, instead of commanding the evil powers himself to withdraw immediately.

The enumeration of demonic activity in the air, water, underworld, fire, nature, and "in the other world" is not in itself clearly contrary to doctrine, but it can leave the impression of being an established Catholic cartography of evil spirits; the described sources do not confirm this.
The expression "we take authority" should be understood as relying on Christ and praying for God's protection, and not as personal or automatic authority over spiritual powers.

sections.subtitle_en: Deliverance prayer: "I bind all evil forces and powers"
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host speaks the prayer of deliverance and protection against evil powers
sections.content_en:
The first part of the prayer block is the **prayer of deliverance and protection**. The host in the name of Jesus "takes authority" and binds all evil forces and powers. In doing so, he enumerates them in detail according to the realms in which they can act:

- in the air and on the earth,
- in the water and in the underworld,
- in the next world,
- in nature and in fire.

After that, the prayer turns into praise. The Lord is confessed as "Lord over the entire universe," and glory is given to him "in the name of his creation." The host then in the name of God binds all demonic forces that have "come against us and our families." He places all those gathered under the protection of the **precious blood** shed on the cross.

Heavenly intercessors are also included in the prayer. Protection and intercession at the Sacred Heart of Jesus for all families are sought from Mary, as a mother, with the petition: "Cover us with your mantle of love, so that the enemy may be terrified." Saint Michael and the guardian angels are called upon to defend families in the battle against evil "that prowls about the world."

The climax of this part is a direct command. In the name of Jesus, the host commands all forces and powers of evil to "depart immediately" from those present, their homes, and their land. The prayer ends with thanksgiving to Jesus as the "faithful God" who "feels with us."

sections.subtitle: Sveti Mihael i molitva jedinstva: „neka naša srca kucaju zajedno“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli molitvu jedinstva s Isusom
sections.content:
Slijedi tradicionalna **molitva svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu**. U njoj se on zaziva kao zaštitnik „u boju protiv pakosti i zasjeda đavolskih“. Molitvom se ponizno traži da „vojvoda vojske nebeske“ božanskom krijepošću i jakošću u pakao strovali Sotonu i druge zlobne duhove „koji svijetom obilaze na propast duša“.

Ratnički ton zatim se zamjenjuje nježnijim. Voditelj moli **molitvu jedinstva s Isusom**, kojom se vjernik obraća „ljupkom Isusu“. Molitva je građena kao niz zaziva koji jedan za drugim opisuju potpuno zajedništvo s Kristom:

- neka noge zajedno hode,
- neka ruke budu skupljene u jedinstvu,
- neka srca kucaju zajedno,
- neka duše budu u skladu, a misli kao jedno,
- neka uši zajedno slušaju tišinu,
- neka pogledi duboko prodru jedan u drugi,
- neka usne zajedno mole.

Cilj tog jedinstva izrečen je na kraju: da se „zadobije milosrđe od vječnoga Oca“. Time se najavljuje središnja tema cijele epizode, a to je Božje milosrđe.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u skladu s katoličkim naukom: molitva svetom Mihaelu izražava biblijsku stvarnost duhovne borbe, a zazivi jedinstva s Isusom skladno odražavaju Kristovu želju da njegovi učenici budu jedno. Traženje Očeva milosrđa u tom zajedništvu ne umanjuje Kristovo posredništvo, nego ga pretpostavlja.
magisterium.enrichment: Sveti Mihael u Otkrivenju sudjeluje u borbi protiv Zmaja, a Crkva ga zaziva kao pomoć u kušnjama i obrani od zla; takva molitva traži Božju pomoć, a ne pripisuje anđelu vlast neovisnu o Bogu. Kristovo jedinstvo s vjernicima ne briše razliku između Krista i njegovih učenika, nego ih povezuje kao Glavu i udove te ih osposobljava za rast u ljubavi. Zato je molitva da se po zajedništvu s Isusom zadobije Očevo milosrđe teološki smislena.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is in alignment with Catholic teaching: the prayer to Saint Michael expresses the biblical reality of spiritual warfare, and the invocations of unity with Jesus harmoniously reflect Christ's desire that his disciples be one. Seeking the Father's mercy in that communion does not diminish Christ's mediation, but presupposes it.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Saint Michael in Revelation participates in the battle against the Dragon, and the Church invokes him as help in temptations and defense against evil; such prayer seeks God's help, and does not attribute to the angel an authority independent of God. Christ's unity with believers does not erase the distinction between Christ and his disciples, but connects them as Head and members and equips them for growth in love. Therefore, the prayer that through communion with Jesus the Father's mercy may be obtained is theologically meaningful.

sections.subtitle_en: Saint Michael and the prayer of unity: "may our hearts beat together"
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the prayer of unity with Jesus
sections.content_en:
There follows the traditional **prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel**. In it, he is invoked as protector "in the battle against the wickedness and snares of the devil." The prayer humbly asks that the "prince of the heavenly host," by divine virtue and power, cast into hell Satan and the other evil spirits "who prowl about the world seeking the ruin of souls."

The combative tone is then replaced by a gentler one. The host prays the **prayer of unity with Jesus**, by which the believer addresses "sweet Jesus." The prayer is constructed as a series of invocations that describe complete communion with Christ one after another:

- may feet walk together,
- may hands be gathered in unity,
- may hearts beat together,
- may souls be in harmony, and thoughts as one,
- may ears listen together to the silence,
- may gazes deeply penetrate one another,
- may lips pray together.

The goal of this unity is expressed at the end: to "obtain mercy from the eternal Father." This announces the central theme of the entire episode, which is Divine Mercy.

sections.subtitle: Dvije posvete: Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i Presvetom Srcu Isusovu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara posvetu Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu
sections.content:
Uvodne molitve zaključuju se dvjema posvetama. Prva je **posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu**. U njoj vjernik Presvetoj Djevici, „majci i kraljici“, predaje „čitavo svoje biće, sve misli, riječi i djela“. Mariji dopušta da raspolaže njime i svime što mu pripada, „sada i u vječnosti“. Posveta ima tri navedene svrhe: hvalu i slavu Presvetoga Trojstva, posvećenje Crkve i spasenje svega svijeta.

U drugom dijelu posvete molitelj traži pomoć da živi dostojno svoga **krsnog posvećenja**, kako bi „neopozivo pripadao“ svome Otkupitelju. Moli i da poput Marije sluša poticaje Duha Svetoga te da se u njemu i u svemu vrši volja Božja.

Druga je **posveta Presvetom Srcu Isusovu**, koje se naziva „izvorom svakoga dobra“. Vjernik se ovdje klanja, ispovijeda vjeru, ufanje i ljubav te se kaje za svoje grijehe. Isusu poklanja svoje „siromašno srce“ i moli da ga učini poniznim, strpljivim i čistim, da u svemu odgovara Njegovim željama. Uz molbu „da ja živim u tebi i ti u meni“ dolaze i konkretne potrebe:

- zaštita u opasnostima,
- utjeha u nevoljama i žalostima,
- zdravlje tijela,
- blagoslov za sav rad,
- milost svete smrti.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom u skladu s katoličkim naukom: posveta Marijinu Srcu prikazana je kao predanje koje vodi Kristu, a posveta Presvetom Srcu uključuje klanjanje, vjeru, kajanje i molbu za život u sjedinjenju s Isusom. Molitve za zdravlje, pomoć u nevoljama i milost svete smrti prikladne su prošnje, pod uvjetom da se ne shvate kao jamstvo željenog ishoda.
concerns: Izraz da Marija raspolaže osobom i svime što joj pripada, sada i u vječnosti, može zvučati kao da joj se pripisuje vlast koja pripada Bogu; u katoličkom smislu treba ga razumjeti kao čin povjerenja i predanja njezinu majčinskom zagovoru, uvijek usmjerenom Kristu, a ne kao štovanje Marije ili zamjenu za pripadnost Kristu.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveno učiteljstvo tumači predanje Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu kao put koji nas po njezinu zagovoru vodi Srcu Isusovu: Marija je povezana sa spasenjskim poslanjem Sina, ali sve usmjerava Kristu, koji odgovara na molitve i oprašta grijehe. Krštenje već označuje pripadnost Kristu; pobožna posveta Mariji može to predanje izričito produbiti, ali ga ne zamjenjuje. Molbe za tjelesnu pomoć i svetu smrt ostaju prošnje upućene s pouzdanjem u Boga i Marijin zagovor, a ne tvrdnja da će svaka tražena korist nužno biti udijeljena.

citations.document_title: To participants in the International Symposium on the Alliance of the Hearts of Jesus and Mary (September 22, 1986) - Speech
De Exorcismis et Supplicationibus Quibusdam (Exorcisms and Other Supplications)

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is mainly in alignment with Catholic teaching: consecration to Mary's Heart is presented as a surrender that leads to Christ, and consecration to the Sacred Heart includes adoration, faith, repentance, and a plea for life in union with Jesus. Prayers for health, help in adversities, and the grace of a holy death are appropriate petitions, provided they are not understood as a guarantee of the desired outcome.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church's Magisterium interprets surrender to the Immaculate Heart of Mary as a path that through her intercession leads us to the Heart of Jesus: Mary is united with the saving mission of the Son, but directs everything to Christ, who answers prayers and forgives sins. Baptism already signifies belonging to Christ; pious consecration to Mary can explicitly deepen that surrender, but does not replace it. Petitions for physical help and a holy death remain petitions made with trust in God and Mary's intercession, and not a claim that every requested benefit will necessarily be granted.
concerns_en: The expression that Mary has at her disposal the person and everything that belongs to them, now and in eternity, may sound as if authority belonging to God is attributed to her; in the Catholic sense it should be understood as an act of trust and surrender to her maternal intercession, always directed toward Christ, and not as worship of Mary or a substitute for belonging to Christ.

sections.subtitle_en: Two consecrations: to the Immaculate Heart of Mary and the Sacred Heart of Jesus
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host pronounces the consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
sections.content_en:
The opening prayers conclude with two consecrations. The first is the **consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary**. In it, the believer surrenders to the Blessed Virgin, "mother and queen," "one's entire being, all thoughts, words, and deeds." The believer permits Mary to dispose of him and of all that belongs to him, "now and in eternity." The consecration has three stated purposes: the praise and glory of the Most Holy Trinity, the sanctification of the Church, and the salvation of the whole world.

In the second part of the consecration, the petitioner asks for help to live worthily of one's **baptismal consecration**, in order to "belong irrevocably" to one's Redeemer. He also prays that, like Mary, he may listen to the promptings of the Holy Spirit and that in him and in everything the will of God may be done.

The second is the **consecration to the Sacred Heart of Jesus**, which is called "the source of every good." Here the believer adores, professes faith, hope, and love, and repents for his sins. He presents his "poor heart" to Jesus and prays that He make it humble, patient, and pure, conforming in everything to His desires. Along with the petition "that I may live in you and you in me" come concrete needs as well:

- protection in dangers,
- consolation in afflictions and sorrows,
- health of the body,
- blessing for all work,
- the grace of a holy death.

sections.subtitle: Krunica Božjega milosrđa: „Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci...“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj na početku desetice Krunice Božjega milosrđa prikazuje Ocu tijelo i krv Kristovu
sections.content:
Na 3. minuti i 42. sekundi voditelj najavljuje **Krunicu Božjega milosrđa**. Ona i daje ime epizodi „Milosrđe Božje“. Krunica počinje uobičajenim molitvama: Očenašem, Zdravomarijom i Apostolskim vjerovanjem. U Vjerovanju se ispovijeda vjera u Boga Oca Stvoritelja, u Isusa Krista „mučena pod Poncijem Pilatom“, raspeta, umrla, pokopana i uskrsla, te u Duha Svetoga, Crkvu, općinstvo svetih, oproštenje grijeha, uskrsnuće tijela i život vječni.

Srž ove krunice su desetice koje se otvaraju zazivom upućenim Ocu:

> „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo preljubljenoga Sina tvojega, Gospodina našega Isusa Krista, kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe naše i cijeloga svijeta.“

Nakon toga deset puta se ponavlja kratki zaziv: **„Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci, budi milosrdan nama i cijelome svijetu.“** Voditelj kroz pet desetica mirno ponavlja isti obrazac. Od otprilike 5. do 11. minute emisija tako gotovo posve prelazi u ritam meditativnog ponavljanja.

U ovoj molitvi naglasak nije na raznolikosti riječi nego na ustrajnosti. Iznova se podsjeća na Kristovu muku kao temelj na kojem molitelj traži milosrđe, i to ne samo za sebe nego „za cijeli svijet“.

magisterium.assessment: Opis Krunice Božjega milosrđa i njezina zaziva za milosrđe nad nama i cijelim svijetom usklađen je s katoličkom vjerom: molitva se oslanja na Kristovu muku i prikazuje Ocu Kristovo tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe. Naglasak na ustrajnoj molitvi za sve ljude primjereno izražava univerzalni doseg Kristova otkupiteljskog djela.
magisterium.enrichment: Izraz „prikazujemo ti” ne znači da se Kristova žrtva na križu ponavlja: riječ je o molitvenom sjedinjenju s jedinstvenom Kristovom žrtvom, koju Crkva sakramentalno slavi u euharistiji. Sveto pismo govori o Kristu koji je prinio svoj život za grijehe, a Prva Ivanova poslanica naglašava da je on žrtva pomirnica „za grijehe svega svijeta”.

citations.document_title: Diary of Saint Maria Faustina Kowalska: Divine Mercy in My Soul
Look on the Faith of Your Church: Mary’s Assent and the Task of Theology

magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the Chaplet of the Divine Mercy and its invocation for mercy on us and on the whole world is aligned with the Catholic faith: the prayer relies on Christ's Passion and offers to the Father the Body and Blood, Soul and Divinity of Christ as propitiation for sins. The emphasis on persevering prayer for all people appropriately expresses the universal scope of Christ's redemptive work.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The expression "we offer you" does not mean that Christ's sacrifice on the cross is repeated: it is a matter of prayerful union with the unique sacrifice of Christ, which the Church celebrates sacramentally in the Eucharist. Sacred Scripture speaks of Christ offering his life for sins, and the First Epistle of John emphasizes that he is the expiation "for the sins of the whole world."

sections.subtitle_en: Chaplet of Divine Mercy: "For the sake of His sorrowful Passion..."
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host at the beginning of a decade of the Chaplet of Divine Mercy offers the body and blood of Christ to the Father
sections.content_en:
At 3 minutes and 42 seconds, the host announces the **Chaplet of Divine Mercy**. It gives its name to the episode "Divine Mercy." The Chaplet begins with the customary prayers: the Our Father, the Hail Mary, and the Apostles' Creed. In the Creed, faith is professed in God the Father Creator, in Jesus Christ "suffered under Pontius Pilate," crucified, died, buried, and resurrected, and in the Holy Spirit, the Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting.

The core of this chaplet is the decades that open with an invocation addressed to the Father:

> "Eternal Father, we offer you the body and blood, soul and divinity of your dearly beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world."

After that, the short invocation is repeated ten times: **"For the sake of his sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world."** The host calmly repeats the same pattern through five decades. From roughly the 5th to the 11th minute, the broadcast thus shifts almost entirely into the rhythm of meditative repetition.

In this prayer, the emphasis is not on diversity of words, but on perseverance. Again and again, Christ's Passion is recalled as the foundation on which the petitioner asks for mercy, and that not only for oneself, but "for the whole world."

sections.subtitle: „Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože“ i trostruko „Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj triput moli zaziv „Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože“
sections.content:
Krunica milosrđa završava trostrukim zazivom: **„Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože, smiluj se nama i cijelomu svijetu.“** Zaziv se svečano ponavlja tri puta.

Zatim voditelj moli zaziv upućen Kristovu probodenom boku:

> „O krvi i vodo, što potekoste iz srca Isusova, kao izvor milosrđa za nas, uzdam se u tebe.“

Slijedi zaziv Mariji kao **majci milosrđa**: „Marijo, majko milosrđa, moli za nas.“ Dio završava tri puta ponovljenim i jednostavnim izrazom predanja: **„Isuse, uzdam se u tebe.“** Krunica se zaključuje molbom „Smiluj se nama i cijelomu svijetu, Gospodine.“ Taj obrat od molbe prema pouzdanju zatim se izravno nastavlja u litanijama.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je usklađen s katoličkom pobožnošću i biblijskim svjedočanstvom: Trisagion je biblijski i liturgijski zaziv, a zaziv krvi i vode iz Isusova boka upućuje na Iv 19,34 i otajstvo Kristove spasenjske ljubavi. Pouzdanje u Isusa i molba Mariji da zagovara za nas izražavaju katoličko razumijevanje Božjeg milosrđa i Marijina majčinskog zagovora.
magisterium.enrichment: Zaziv „Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože” povezuje pobožnost sa slavljenjem Boga koje se nadahnjuje biblijskim „Svet, svet, svet” i liturgijskim predajama. Krv i voda iz probodenog Kristova boka podsjećaju na njegovu žrtvu te, u Ivanovoj simbolici, na darove euharistije, krštenja i Duha Svetoga; Marija je majka milosrđa jer je intimno sudjelovala u otajstvu ljubavi svoga Sina, a ne izvor milosrđa neovisan o Kristu.

citations.document_title: Directory on Popular Piety and the Liturgy: Principles and Guidelines
citations.document_author: Congregation for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is aligned with Catholic devotion and biblical testimony: the Trisagion is a biblical and liturgical invocation, and the invocation of the Blood and Water from Jesus' side points to Jn 19:34 and the mystery of Christ's saving love. Trust in Jesus and the plea to Mary to intercede for us express the Catholic understanding of the Divine Mercy and Mary's maternal intercession.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The invocation "Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One" connects devotion with the praise of God inspired by the biblical "Holy, Holy, Holy" and liturgical traditions. The blood and water from the pierced side of Christ recall his sacrifice and, in Johannine symbolism, the gifts of the Eucharist, baptism, and the Holy Spirit; Mary is the mother of mercy because she intimately shared in the mystery of her Son's love, not a source of mercy independent of Christ.

sections.subtitle_en: "Holy God, Holy Mighty God" and the threefold "Jesus, I trust in You"
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays three times the invocation "Holy God, Holy Mighty God, Holy Immortal God"
sections.content_en:
The Chaplet of Mercy concludes with the threefold invocation: **"Holy God, Holy Mighty God, Holy Immortal God, have mercy on us and on the whole world."** The invocation is solemnly repeated three times.

Then the host prays the invocation addressed to Christ's pierced side:

> "O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fount of Mercy for us, I trust in You."

There follows the invocation to Mary as **mother of mercy**: "Mary, mother of mercy, pray for us." The section concludes with the threefold repeated and simple expression of surrender: **"Jesus, I trust in you."** The Chaplet concludes with the petition "Have mercy on us and on the whole world, Lord." That turn from petition toward trust then continues directly into the litany.

sections.subtitle: Litanije Božjem milosrđu: od stvaranja do čistilišta
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj predmoli litanije Božjem milosrđu i ponavlja „uzdam se u tebe“
sections.content:
Na 12. minuti i 33. sekundi počinju **Litanije Božjem milosrđu**. Otvaraju se klasičnim zazivima „Gospodine, smiluj se. Kriste, smiluj se“, zatim „Kriste, čuj nas. Kriste, usliši nas“ te zazivima Ocu nebeskom, Sinu Otkupitelju svijeta, Duhu Svetom i Svetom Trojstvu.

Nakon toga slijedi dugačak niz zaziva koji počinju riječima „Milosrđe Božje“. Svi završavaju istim odgovorom: **„uzdam se u tebe“**. Zazivi zajedno opisuju milosrđe kroz cijelu povijest spasenja i kroz sve životne situacije. Božje milosrđe u njima se naziva:

- „neshvatljivom tajnom Presvetoga Trojstva“ i „izrazom njegove najveće moći“,
- milosrđem koje se objavilo u stvaranju nebeskih duhova i koje je ljude „iz ništavila pozvalo u život“,
- milosrđem koje obuhvaća čitav svijet, daruje besmrtan život i štiti od zasluženih kazni,
- milosrđem koje oslobađa od bijede grijeha i koje se izlijeva iz rana Kristovih i iz Presvetoga Srca,
- milosrđem koje je ljudima dalo Presvetu Djevicu za majku milosrđa,
- milosrđem vidljivim u ustanovljenju Crkve i svetih sakramenata, „neograničenim“ u krštenju i pokori te „neizmjernim“ u sakramentu oltara i svećeništva,
- milosrđem koje poziva na vjeru, obraća grešnike, posvećuje pravednike i usavršuje svete.

Veliki dio litanija posvećen je onima koji pate. Milosrđe se zaziva kao „vrelo bolesnicima i patnicima“, „utjeha i blago“ onih skršena srca, „ufanje onih koji očajavaju“ i „mir umirućih“. Zazivi sežu i dalje od zemaljskog života: milosrđe „čuva od paklenoga ognja“, „olakšava patnje dušama u čistilištu“ i „slast je i neizmjerna radost svih svetih“.

Litanije završavaju zazivima milosrđa kao „beskrajnog u svim tajnama vjere“ i „neiscrpivog izvora čudesa“. Na kraju je psalamski redak: „Bog je milosrdan i pun samilosti, spor na srdžbu i pun dobrote. Zato ću dovijeka klicati milosrđu Božjemu.“

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u visokoj mjeri usklađen s katoličkom vjerom: prikazuje milosrđe u djelovanju Presvetoga Trojstva, stvaranju, Kristovu otkupljenju, životu Crkve i nadi za pokojne, bez očite doktrinarne proturječnosti. Govor o olakšanju patnji dušama u čistilištu odgovara katoličkom nauku o čistilištu i koristi molitava živih za pokojne.
magisterium.enrichment: Izrazi poput „neograničeno“ milosrđe u krštenju i pokori te „neizmjerno“ u Euharistiji i svećeništvu najbolje se razumiju kao pobožna, slikovita pohvala Božjem djelovanju, a ne kao zasebne precizne dogmatske definicije; sakramenti su sredstva oproštenja i posvećenja, a za pokojne Crkva moli i prikazuje misne žrtve te druga djela pobožnosti. Završni redak opisan je kao psalamski, no iz dostavljenog sažetka nije moguće pouzdano utvrditi njegov točan biblijski navod.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is highly aligned with the Catholic faith: it portrays mercy in the action of the Most Holy Trinity, creation, Christ's redemption, the life of the Church, and hope for the deceased, without obvious doctrinal contradiction. Speaking of easing suffering for souls in purgatory corresponds to Catholic teaching on purgatory and the benefit of the prayers of the living for the deceased.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Expressions such as "unlimited" mercy in baptism and penance and "immense" in the Eucharist and priesthood are best understood as pious, vivid praise of God's action, rather than as separate precise dogmatic definitions; the sacraments are means of forgiveness and sanctification, and for the deceased the Church prays and offers Mass sacrifices and other works of piety. The concluding line is described as psalmic, but from the provided summary it is not possible to reliably determine its exact biblical citation.

sections.subtitle_en: Litany of Divine Mercy: from creation to purgatory
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host leads the Litany of Divine Mercy and repeats "I trust in You"
sections.content_en:
At 12 minutes and 33 seconds, the **Litany of Divine Mercy** begins. It opens with the classic invocations "Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy," then "Christ, hear us. Christ, graciously hear us," and invocations to the heavenly Father, the Son Redeemer of the world, the Holy Spirit, and the Holy Trinity.

After that follows a long series of invocations that begin with the words "Divine Mercy." All end with the same response: **"I trust in you"**. The invocations together describe mercy throughout the entire history of salvation and through all life situations. Divine mercy is named in them as:

- the "incomprehensible mystery of the Most Holy Trinity" and "the expression of His greatest power",
- mercy that manifested itself in the creation of heavenly spirits and that called people "out of nothingness into life",
- mercy that embraces the entire world, bestows immortal life, and protects from deserved punishments,
- mercy that liberates from the misery of sin and that flows from the wounds of Christ and from the Sacred Heart,
- mercy that gave people the Blessed Virgin as mother of mercy,
- mercy visible in the institution of the Church and holy sacraments, "unlimited" in baptism and penance and "immeasurable" in the sacrament of the altar and priesthood,
- mercy that calls to faith, converts sinners, sanctifies the righteous, and perfects the saints.

A large part of the litany is dedicated to those who suffer. Mercy is invoked as the "source for the sick and suffering," "consolation and treasure" of the brokenhearted, "hope of those who despair," and "peace of the dying." The invocations extend even beyond earthly life: mercy "guards from the fire of hell," "relieves the suffering of souls in purgatory," and is the "sweetness and immense joy of all the saints."

The litany concludes with invocations of mercy as "boundless in all mysteries of faith" and "an inexhaustible source of miracles." At the end is the psalm verse: "God is merciful and full of compassion, slow to anger and full of goodness. Therefore I will sing of the mercy of God forever."

sections.subtitle: Završna molitva: da u teškim trenucima ne očajavamo
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj poziva „Pomolimo se“ i izgovara završnu molitvu vječnom Bogu milosrđa
sections.content:
Pobožnost milosrđu zaključuje se zbornom molitvom koju voditelj uvodi riječima „Pomolimo se“. Vječnom se Bogu obraća kao onome čije je milosrđe „neistraživo“ i čije je „blago smilovanja neiscrpivo“.

Molba je izrazito pastoralna. Bog se moli da u vjernicima umnoži svoje milosrđe, kako u **teškim trenucima ne bi očajavali niti bili obeshrabreni**. Umjesto toga, moli se da se s velikim pouzdanjem predaju Njegovoj svetoj volji, „koja je sama ljubav i smilovanje“.

Molitva završava po Isusu Kristu, kojeg naziva **„kraljem milosrđa“** i koji „s Ocem i Duhom Svetim iskazuje milosrđe u sve vijeke vjekova“. Time se zatvara prvi, dvadesetak minuta dug dio emisije, posvećen isključivo Božjem milosrđu.

magisterium.assessment: Molitva je snažno usklađena s katoličkim naukom: potiče pouzdanje u Božje milosrđe i predanje Božjoj volji u kušnjama, bez poticanja na očaj ili obeshrabrenost. Nazivanje Krista „kraljem milosrđa“ i završetak u ime Trojstva u skladu su s kršćanskom vjerom.
magisterium.enrichment: Pouzdanje u kušnjama ne znači poricanje boli, nego povjeravanje Bogu usred nje; sveti Ivan Pavao II. opisuje predanje Božjoj ljubavi kao izvor mira i snage u životnim teškoćama. Izraz da je Božja volja „ljubav i smilovanje“ također odražava pobožnost svete Faustine, koja govori o pouzdanju u Božju volju kao ljubavi i milosrđu.

citations.document_title: To the Community of the Pontifical Roman Major Seminary on the Feast of Our Lady of Confidence (March 1, 2003) - Speech
Diary of Saint Maria Faustina Kowalska: Divine Mercy in My Soul

magisterium.assessment_en: The prayer is strongly aligned with Catholic teaching: it encourages trust in the Divine Mercy and surrender to God's will in trials, without prompting despair or discouragement. Calling Christ the "King of Mercy" and concluding in the name of the Trinity are in accordance with the Christian faith.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Trust in trials does not mean denying pain, but entrusting oneself to God in the midst of it; Saint John Paul II describes surrender to God's love as a source of peace and strength in life's difficulties. The expression that God's will is "love and mercy" also reflects the devotion of Saint Faustina, who speaks of trust in God's will as love and mercy.

sections.subtitle_en: Concluding prayer: that in difficult moments we do not despair
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host invites "Let us pray" and speaks the concluding prayer to the eternal God of mercy
sections.content_en:
The devotion to mercy concludes with the collect prayer which the host introduces with the words "Let us pray." The eternal God is addressed as the One whose mercy is "unfathomable" and whose "treasury of compassion is inexhaustible."

The petition is distinctly pastoral. God is asked to multiply His mercy in believers, so that in **difficult moments they may neither despair nor be discouraged**. Instead, it is prayed that with great confidence they may surrender to His holy will, "which is love and mercy itself."

The prayer concludes through Jesus Christ, whom he calls the **"King of Mercy"** and who "with the Father and the Holy Spirit shows mercy for ever and ever." With this closes the first, roughly twenty-minute-long part of the broadcast, dedicated exclusively to Divine Mercy.

sections.subtitle: Gospina krunica, otajstva svjetla: Jordan i svadba u Kani
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje Gospinu krunicu i prvo otajstvo – krštenje na rijeci Jordanu
sections.content:
Na 16. minuti i 54. sekundi voditelj najavljuje: **„Slijedi Gospina krunica.“** Moli se otajstva svjetla, koja prate javno djelovanje Isusa Krista.

**Prvo otajstvo** glasi: „Koji je na rijeci Jordanu kršten bio.“ Svaka desetica ima isti, ustaljeni red:

- Očenaš,
- deset Zdravomarija,
- Slava Ocu,
- molitva „O moj Isuse, oprosti nam naše grijehe, očuvaj nas od paklenoga ognja, dovedi u raj sve duše, a osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe.“

Posljednji zaziv, koji se moli na kraju svake desetice, povezuje Gospinu krunicu s prethodnom pobožnošću. I ovdje se završava molbom za milosrđe, i to za one kojima je ono „najpotrebnije“.

**Drugo otajstvo**, koje počinje na 20. minuti i 49. sekundi, glasi: „Koji je na svadbi u Kani objavio svoju slavu.“ Voditelj ga moli istim mirnim ritmom kao i prvo. Molitva se ne prekida komentarima ni tumačenjima. Cijeli prostor ostavljen je ponavljanju Zdravomarije i razmatranju otajstva.

magisterium.assessment: Opisani zazivi i molitveni obrazac usklađeni su s katoličkom pobožnošću krunice: otajstva svjetla usmjeravaju razmatranje na Kristovo javno djelovanje, a krštenje na Jordanu i znak u Kani vjerno su utemeljeni u evanđeoskim događajima. Molitva za Božje milosrđe i za duše kojima je ono najpotrebnije izražava prošnju za spasenje i ne unosi nikakvu očitu doktrinarnu nejasnoću.
magisterium.enrichment: Sveti Ivan Pavao II. ističe da se na Jordanu objavljuje Isus kao ljubljeni Sin Očev, dok u Kani Isus očituje svoju slavu i učenici počinju vjerovati u njega; zato su ta otajstva prikladan početak razmatranja Kristova javnog djelovanja. U Kani Marija upućuje služitelje da učine sve što im Isus kaže, pa krunica ne zaustavlja pozornost na Mariji umjesto na Kristu, nego kroz njezino posredovanje vodi prema vjeri i poslušnosti Kristu.

citations.document_title: Rosarium Virginis Mariae on the Most Holy Rosary

citations.document_author: The New Revised Standard Version, Catholic Edition (NRSV-CE)

magisterium.assessment_en: The described invocations and prayer pattern are aligned with the Catholic devotion of the Rosary: the Luminous Mysteries direct contemplation to Christ's public ministry, and the Baptism in the Jordan and the sign at Cana are faithfully grounded in Gospel events. The prayer for the Divine Mercy and for souls who need it most expresses a petition for salvation and introduces no obvious doctrinal ambiguity.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Saint John Paul II points out that at the Jordan Jesus is revealed as the beloved Son of the Father, while at Cana Jesus manifests his glory and the disciples begin to believe in him; therefore, these mysteries are a fitting beginning to the contemplation of Christ's public ministry. At Cana, Mary directs the servants to do whatever Jesus tells them, so the Rosary does not detain attention on Mary instead of Christ, but through her mediation leads toward faith and obedience to Christ.

sections.subtitle_en: Our Lady's Rosary, luminous mysteries: the Jordan and the wedding at Cana
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces Our Lady's Rosary and the first mystery – the baptism in the Jordan River
sections.content_en:
At 16 minutes and 54 seconds, the host announces: **"Our Lady's Rosary follows."** The luminous mysteries are prayed, which follow the public ministry of Jesus Christ.

**The first mystery** reads: "Who was baptized in the Jordan River." Each decade has the same, established order:

- Our Father,
- ten Hail Marys,
- Glory Be to the Father,
- the prayer "O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, lead all souls to heaven, especially those who are most in need of your mercy."

The final invocation, which is prayed at the end of each decade, connects Our Lady's Rosary with the preceding devotion. Here too, it ends with a plea for mercy, specifically for those who are "most in need" of it.

**The second mystery**, which begins at 20 minutes and 49 seconds, reads: "Who manifested his glory at the wedding at Cana." The host prays it with the same calm rhythm as the first. The prayer is not interrupted by comments or interpretations. The entire space is left to the repetition of the Hail Mary and the contemplation of the mystery.

sections.subtitle: Od poziva na obraćenje do euharistije: preostala tri otajstva svjetla
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje peto otajstvo svjetla – ustanovljenje svete euharistije na posljednjoj večeri
sections.content:
**Treće otajstvo**, na 24. minuti i 50. sekundi, sadrži Isusov navještaj: „Koji je navijestio: ‘Obratite se, kraljevstvo Božje je blizu.’“ Tema obraćenja provlači se kroz cijelu epizodu i već se pojavila u litanijama, gdje se milosrđe zazivalo „u obraćenju grešnika“.

**Četvrto otajstvo**, koje počinje na 28. minuti i 49. sekundi, posvećeno je preobraženju: „Koji se na gori Taboru preobrazio.“

**Peto otajstvo**, na 32. minuti i 42. sekundi, zaključuje niz otajstava svjetla: „Koji je na posljednjoj večeri ustanovio svetu euharistiju.“ To se povezuje sa zazivom iz litanija u kojem se milosrđe naziva „neizmjernim u sakramentu oltara i svećeništva“.

I ova tri otajstva voditelj moli bez prekida i dodatnih objašnjenja. Svako završava doksologijom „Slava Ocu i Sinu i Duhu Svetomu“ i molitvom „O moj Isuse“. Nakon petog otajstva krunica završava.

magisterium.assessment: Opis trećeg, četvrtog i petog otajstva svjetla u skladu je s katoličkim naukom: obuhvaća Isusov poziv na obraćenje, preobraženje i ustanovljenje Euharistije. Navedeni sadržaj odgovara otajstvima koja je sveti Ivan Pavao II. izričito predložio za razmatranje u krunici, a sažeci su u skladu sa Svetim pismom.
magisterium.enrichment: Isusov navještaj povezuje blizinu Božjega kraljevstva s pozivom na obraćenje i vjeru, pa obraćenje nije sporedna tema nego odgovor na Božje djelovanje i poziv upućen svima. Preobraženje očituje Kristovu slavu i pripravlja učenike za njegovu muku, dok je Euharistija sakramentalni izraz vazmenoga otajstva, odnosno Kristove ljubavi i predanja za spasenje ljudi.

The Bible and Morality: Biblical Roots of Christian Conduct

magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the third, fourth, and fifth Luminous Mysteries is in accordance with Catholic teaching: it encompasses Jesus' call to conversion, the Transfiguration, and the institution of the Eucharist. The listed content corresponds to the mysteries that Saint John Paul II explicitly proposed for contemplation in the Rosary, and the summaries are in accordance with Sacred Scripture.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Jesus' proclamation connects the nearness of the Kingdom of God with the call to conversion and faith, so conversion is not a secondary theme but a response to God's action and a call addressed to all. The Transfiguration manifests Christ's glory and prepares the disciples for his Passion, while the Eucharist is the sacramental expression of the Paschal Mystery, that is, of Christ's love and self-giving for the salvation of mankind.

sections.subtitle_en: From the call to conversion to the Eucharist: the remaining three luminous mysteries
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces the fifth luminous mystery – the institution of the holy Eucharist at the Last Supper
sections.content_en:
**The third mystery**, at 24 minutes and 50 seconds, contains Jesus' proclamation: "Who proclaimed: 'Repent, the kingdom of God is at hand.'" The theme of conversion runs through the entire episode and already appeared in the litany, where mercy was invoked "in the conversion of sinners."

**The fourth mystery**, which begins at 28 minutes and 49 seconds, is dedicated to the transfiguration: "Who was transfigured on Mount Tabor."

**The fifth mystery**, at 32 minutes and 42 seconds, concludes the series of luminous mysteries: "Who instituted the holy Eucharist at the Last Supper." This connects with the invocation from the litany in which mercy is called "immeasurable in the sacrament of the altar and priesthood."

The host prays these three mysteries as well without interruption and additional explanations. Each ends with the doxology "Glory be to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit" and the prayer "O my Jesus." After the fifth mystery, the rosary ends.

sections.subtitle: „Zdravo Kraljice“: vapaj prognanih sinova Evinih
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli završnu marijansku antifonu „Zdravo Kraljice, majko milosrđa“
sections.content:
Molitveni dio emisije zatvara se drevnom marijanskom molitvom **„Zdravo Kraljice“**. Ona se dobro nadovezuje na temu dana, jer Mariju odmah u prvom retku naziva **„majkom milosrđa“**, uz „život, slast i ufanje naše“.

Vjernici se u molitvi predstavljaju kao „prognani sinovi Evini“ koji vapiju i uzdišu „tugujući i plačući u ovoj suznoj dolini“. Mariju mole kao zagovornicu da na njih svrne „svoje milostive oči“ i da im „poslije ovoga progona“ pokaže Isusa, „blagoslovljeni plod utrobe svoje“.

Molitva završava trostrukim nježnim zazivom: **„O blaga, o mila, o slatka Djevice Marijo.“** Time završava gotovo 37 minuta dug molitveni blok, koji je obuhvatio zaštitne molitve, posvete, Krunicu i Litanije Božjem milosrđu te Gospinu krunicu. Nakon njega slijedi tumačenje Svete riječi.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak vjerno prikazuje sadržaj i katoličko značenje molitve „Zdravo Kraljice“: Mariju zaziva kao majku i zagovornicu, a završni pogled molitve usmjerava prema Isusu. Taj je marijanski zagovor u skladu s katoličkim naukom kada se razumije kao majčinsko posredovanje koje potpuno ovisi o Kristu, a ne kao neovisni izvor milosti.
magisterium.enrichment: Slika „prognanih sinova Evinih“ izražava stanje čovječanstva obilježeno grijehom i patnjom, dok se zaziv Mariji kao „novoj Evi“ oslanja na katoličku predaju o njezinoj suradnji s Kristom, novim Adamom, u djelu spasenja. Crkveno tumačenje naziva „Zagovornica“ naglašava da Marija naše molitve prikazuje Kristu i majčinski zagovara za nas; zato molitva svoj vrhunac ne nalazi u Mariji odvojeno od njezina Sina, nego u molbi da nam pokaže Isusa. Izraz „poslije ovoga progona“ razumljiv je kao parafraza tradicionalnog „poslije ovoga našeg progonstva“ i ne mijenja temeljno značenje molitve.

citations.document_title: Extraordinary Jubilee of Mercy: Spiritual Retreat given by Pope Francis on the occasion of the Jubilee for Priests. Second meditation (Basilica of Saint Mary Major, 2 June 2016)

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage faithfully presents the content and Catholic meaning of the prayer "Hail, Holy Queen" (Salve Regina): it invokes Mary as mother and advocate, and directs the final gaze of the prayer toward Jesus. That Marian intercession is in accordance with Catholic teaching when understood as maternal mediation entirely dependent on Christ, not as an independent source of grace.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The image of the "banished children of Eve" expresses the state of humanity marked by sin and suffering, while the invocation of Mary as the "new Eve" relies on Catholic tradition concerning her cooperation with Christ, the new Adam, in the work of salvation. The Church's interpretation of the title "Advocate" emphasizes that Mary presents our prayers to Christ and maternally intercedes for us; therefore, the prayer finds its culmination not in Mary apart from her Son, but in the petition that she show unto us Jesus. The expression "after this exile" is understandable as a paraphrase of the traditional "after this our exile" and does not alter the fundamental meaning of the prayer.

sections.subtitle_en: "Hail, Holy Queen": the cry of the banished children of Eve
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the concluding Marian antiphon "Hail, Holy Queen, mother of mercy"
sections.content_en:
The prayer part of the broadcast closes with the ancient Marian prayer **"Hail, Holy Queen"**. It ties in well with the theme of the day, because in the very first line it calls Mary **"mother of mercy"**, along with "our life, our sweetness, and our hope."

In the prayer, believers present themselves as "banished children of Eve" who cry and sigh "mourning and weeping in this valley of tears." They pray to Mary as an intercessor to turn "her merciful eyes" toward them and, "after this our exile," show them Jesus, "the blessed fruit of her womb."

The prayer ends with a threefold gentle invocation: **"O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary."** This ends the almost 37-minute-long prayer block, which encompassed prayers of protection, consecrations, the Chaplet and Litany of Divine Mercy, and Our Lady's Rosary. Following it is the interpretation of the Holy Word.

sections.subtitle: Poslanica Efežanima kao bojni plan: „Obucite svu opremu Božju“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj započinje čitanje iz Poslanice Efežanima o opremi Božjoj
sections.content:
Nakon molitve krunice Božjega milosrđa i Gospine krunice, emisija prelazi u svoj središnji, poučni dio. Voditelj Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje tumačenje svete riječi i čita poznati odlomak iz šestog poglavlja **Poslanice Efežanima**. U njemu apostol Pavao kršćane poziva da se jačaju „u Gospodinu i u silnoj snazi njegovoj“ te da obuku svu opremu Božju kako bi se mogli oduprijeti lukavstvima đavlovim.

Pročitani tekst donosi cijeli popis duhovne opreme, a voditelj će ga u nastavku tumačiti dio po dio:

- **opasati bedra istinom**,
- **obući oklop pravednosti**,
- **potpasati noge spremnošću za evanđelje mira**,
- **imati uza se štit vjere**, kojim se gase ognjene strijele zloga,
- **uzeti kacigu spasenja**,
- **uzeti mač duha, to jest riječ Božju**,
- **moliti se u duhu svakovrsnom molitvom i prošnjom** te bdjeti sa svom ustrajnošću.

Odlomak završava Pavlovom molbom da mu se otvore usta kako bi, iako „poslanik u okovima“, hrabro obznanio otajstvo evanđelja. Taj tekst postaje okvir cijelog tumačenja, kao svojevrsni bojni plan za vjernika u duhovnoj borbi.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak vjerno prikazuje Efežanima 6,10–20: navodi poziv na Božju opremu, njezine sastavnice, molitvu i Pavlovu molbu za hrabro naviještanje evanđelja. Opis kao „bojni plan” prikladna je metafora duhovne borbe, pod uvjetom da se ne shvati kao poziv na nasilje ili neprijateljstvo prema ljudima.
magisterium.enrichment: Pavao izričito pojašnjava da kršćanska borba nije protiv „krvi i mesa”, nego protiv duhovnih sila zla, pa slika opreme usmjerava vjernika na postojanost u istini, pravednosti, vjeri i evanđelju mira. Papa Franjo povezuje tu borbu s konkretnim sredstvima kršćanskoga života: molitvom, Božjom riječju, sakramentima, djelima ljubavi, životom zajednice i misijskim poslanjem.

citations.document_author: The New Revised Standard Version, Catholic Edition (NRSV-CE)

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage faithfully presents Ephesians 6:10–20: it cites the call to the armor of God, its components, prayer, and Paul's request for boldness in proclaiming the Gospel. The description as a "battle plan" is an appropriate metaphor for spiritual warfare, provided it is not understood as a call to violence or hostility toward people.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Paul explicitly clarifies that Christian warfare is not against "flesh and blood," but against the spiritual forces of evil, so the imagery of the armor directs the believer toward steadfastness in truth, righteousness, faith, and the gospel of peace. Pope Francis connects this struggle with the concrete means of Christian life: prayer, the Word of God, sacraments, works of charity, community life, and missionary mandate.

sections.subtitle_en: The Epistle to the Ephesians as a battle plan: "Put on the whole armor of God"
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host begins reading from the Epistle to the Ephesians about the armor of God
sections.content_en:
After the prayer of the Chaplet of Divine Mercy and Our Lady's Rosary, the broadcast transitions into its central, instructional part. The host Vladimir Grebenar announces the interpretation of the holy word and reads the well-known passage from the sixth chapter of the **Epistle to the Ephesians**. In it, the apostle Paul calls Christians to be strong "in the Lord and in the strength of his might" and to put on the whole armor of God so that they may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

The text that was read provides a complete list of spiritual armor, and the host will interpret it section by section below:

- **gird the loins with truth**,
- **put on the breastplate of righteousness**,
- **shod feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace**,
- **hold up the shield of faith**, with which flaming darts of the evil one are extinguished,
- **take the helmet of salvation**,
- **take the sword of the spirit, which is the word of God**,
- **pray in the spirit with all manner of prayer and supplication** and keep alert with all perseverance.

The passage ends with Paul's request that his mouth be opened so that, although an "ambassador in chains," he might boldly make known the mystery of the gospel. That text becomes the framework of the entire interpretation, as a kind of battle plan for the believer in spiritual warfare.

sections.subtitle: Neprijatelj nije čovjek: kako prepoznati one pod vlašću zloga
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj objašnjava da se ne borimo protiv ljudi, nego protiv zlih duhova
sections.content:
Prva poanta tumačenja jest da se, prema svetom Pavlu, **ne borimo protiv krvi i mesa, nego protiv zlih duhova**. Voditelj upozorava da danas mnogi gledaju na ljude s druge strane kao na neprijatelje. Apostol, međutim, jasno kaže da je stvarna borba duhovna. Pod vlašću zloga, objašnjava Grebenar, nalaze se mnogi koji su „od svijeta“ i oni koji nemaju vjeru srca. Svi su mu, dodaje, podložni „više ili manje“.

Postavlja zatim ključno pitanje: kako prepoznati da je netko pod vlašću zloga? Odgovor pronalazi u Isusovim riječima „po plodovima ćete ih prepoznati“. Onaj tko **progoni ljude koji donose plodove za kraljevstvo Božje** pokazuje, prema voditelju, da je pod vlašću zloga. To mogu biti ljudi od svijeta koji žive u smrtnom grijehu, ali i oni koji se predstavljaju kao vjernici, a zapravo su **„lažna braća“**.

Voditelj tu misao okreće i prema samim slušateljima. Svatko bi se trebao zapitati stoji li možda i sam na strani lažne braće. Kao **test vjere** predlaže jednostavno pitanje: raduje li se čovjek onome čemu se raduje i njegov Spasitelj? Ako netko ne osjeća radost kad čuje da je brat ili sestra rastao u vjeri, ozdravio ili da mu se dijete vratilo u crkvu nakon droge i alkohola, onda je, upozorava Grebenar, i sam pod vlašću zloga.

magisterium.assessment: Ispravno naglašava da je kršćanska borba duhovna, a ne protiv ljudi, te da se učenici mogu suočiti s protivljenjem zbog vjernosti Kristu. Ipak, izostanak radosti zbog tuđega duhovnog dobra ili progonstvo vjernika samo po sebi ne omogućuje siguran zaključak da je netko „pod vlašću zloga“; takva je dijagnoza previše kategorična.
concerns: Pavlova tvrdnja da se ne borimo protiv krvi i mesa usmjerava pozornost na duhovne sile zla, ali ne opravdava svrstavanje pojedinih ljudi u neprijateljski tabor niti zaključak o njihovu duhovnom stanju.
Isusove riječi o prepoznavanju po plodovima pozivaju na razborito prosuđivanje, ali odlomak ne daje osnovu da se svatko tko progoni osobu koja donosi plodove automatski proglasi pod vlašću zloga.

Ne radovati se tuđem dobru može upućivati na zavist ili manjak ljubavi, ali iz toga se bez dodatnog razlučivanja ne može zaključiti da je osoba pod vlašću zloga; formulacija može poticati neutemeljeno osuđivanje i strah.
magisterium.enrichment: Efežanima 6,12 poziva kršćane da razlikuju duhovnu borbu od neprijateljstva prema ljudima, dok Isusovo upozorenje o plodovima traži razboritost, a ne olako etiketiranje. Progonstvo zbog vjernosti Kristu doista je biblijska stvarnost, ali ono ne daje ovlast da se progoniteljima pripisuje konačno stanje duše. Radovati se tuđem dobru u skladu je s kršćanskom ljubavlju; ipak, procjena nečije krivnje ili duhovnog stanja treba ostati ponizna i oprezna.
